covalent.note: Covalent radius; PubChem's values are those of Cordero et al., Dalton Trans. 2008, 2832.

vdw.note: Van der Waals radius (Los Alamos National Laboratory).

allen.note: Configuration energy (Allen electronegativity) in eV, not converted to the Pauling-like scale; Mann 2000a.

crust.note: Jefferson Lab estimate for Earth's crust, via PubChem ('1.45×10² milligrams per kilogram').

ocean.note: Jefferson Lab estimate for sea water, via PubChem ('1.94×10⁴ milligrams per liter').

solar.note: Proto-solar (4.567 Ga ago) elemental mass fraction, column 'Elemental Mass Fractions' of ESM Table A13; the table gives no uncertainty (relative sigma of N(E) in Table 6 applies).

solarLogEps.note: A(E) = log10(N_E/N_H) + 12, 'Solar System Present' log (E/H)+12; basis: meteoritic (CI-chondrite) value; unc = 1 sigma in dex as printed.

body.note: In a 70 kg reference adult (ICRP Publication 23, 1975, Table 110).

crystal.structure: orthorhombic molecular crystal (layers of Cl2 molecules)
crystal.reference: Powell, B. M.; Heal, K. M.; Torrie, B. H. (1984). Molecular Physics 53, 929.
crystal.note: Low-temperature solid only, at 160 K, the highest temperature in this series (same paper also gives 22, 55 and 100 K).

origin.note: Read off Fig. 39 at the dotted 'age of the Sun' line (t = 9.2 Gyr after the Big Bang, 4.6 Gyr ago): pixel fractions of the stacked areas (massive_stars 0.989, white_dwarfs 0.011); quantised to 0.05. Stack height 14 px. LOW PRECISION: the model abundance is small on this box's scale, so 1 px = 0.07 of the total. Paper: 'For the elements from Ne to Ge, the newly synthesized amounts are very small for AGB stars, and the small green areas are mostly for mass loss.'

plantRole.text: Taken up as chloride; balances charges, helps stomata open and close, and is needed by the water-splitting step of photosynthesis.

humanRole.text: The main negative ion outside cells; part of stomach acid.

history.nameOrigin: From the Greek chloros, 'pale green' or 'yellow-green', the colour of the gas.
history.note: Scheele made the gas from pyrolusite and hydrochloric acid but thought it contained oxygen; Davy showed in 1810 that it is an element and named it.

prose.text: Chlorine is a greenish-yellow, choking gas from the halogen group; we meet it bound and harmless in table salt, while small doses of chlorine or its compounds keep drinking water and swimming pools free of microbes. Natural chlorine is a mixture of two stable isotopes, about 75.8 % chlorine-35 and 24.2 % chlorine-37, which is why its atomic weight, about 35.45, is so far from a whole number. The atom, [Ne] 3s² 3p⁵ (ground term ²P°₃/₂), lacks one electron to close its shell, and it releases more energy on capturing an extra electron than any other element, even fluorine.
